image_description: Two male black grouse (blackcocks) in a grassy field. The bird on the left is in mid-display or flight with wings spread, showing dark plumage and white wing patches. The bird on the right is standing, displaying characteristic bluish-black iridescent plumage, red eyebrow combs, and prominent white undertail coverts.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both visible male subjects clearly display bright red supra-orbital combs.

The torso of the standing bird on the right exhibits the correct robust, rounded proportions.
